spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile standing on four legs against a plain light background. It has the overall body shape, head, fur, and paws of a large brown bear, but most of the dorsal, lateral, and outer leg surfaces are covered by a glossy, hard, dark brown to black segmented exoskeleton with tan seams between plates. The head is furry brown with a dark nose and small brown eyes, and a single long, curved, glossy horn with a small inner prong rises from the center of the forehead. Dense shaggy brown fur is visible on the head, neck, chest, belly margins, and around the paws, while the armor is shiny with fine surface scratches and forms overlapping arched plates over the back, a larger shoulder plate, neck rings, and jointed plates over the limbs. The feet are broad with five long curved claws each, and the rear ends in a short, pointed, segmented tail.

spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile standing on four legs against a plain light background. It has the overall shape, dense shaggy brown fur, and head of a bear, but its dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the tip of the rear is covered by a glossy dark brown segmented exoskeleton with overlapping transverse plates. A single large glossy dark curved horn projects from the center of the forehead. The furry underparts, sides of the neck, and all four limbs contrast with the shiny armored covering, which extends down the sides with rows of oval openings and tapers to a narrow pointed tip at the rear.
